text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: He makes for a pretty tough opponent. But still, it's going to be a piece of cake.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なかなか手ごわい相手だけど、
このくらいなら楽勝よね！

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
I can still fight as well.
Today I'm feeling well enough to take on anyone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私もまだまだ戦えます。
今日は体の調子がすごくいいみたいなので。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
That's promising, but don't overdo yourself.
Only when everyone's safe will the ranch return to how it should be.
text_block_list.orig_text:
頼もしいけど、
無理しちゃだめよ。
みんなが無事で初めて、
いつもの牧場が帰ってくるんだから。

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a lot.
I'll try not to strain myself, but I will see this fight through to the end.
Let's go, Lima.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます。
無理せず全力で、
最後まで戦いますね。
行きましょう、
リマさん。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
You've got this!
And my back is yours for the riding! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かったわ！
私の背中は
シオリちゃんに預けるからね♪
